data_description.serial_port: Use the host device path, such as /dev/serial/by-id/..., for the attached coordinator.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the coordinator serial number. Check the connection settings and make sure the coordinator is responding.

abort.already_configured: This physical Inovonics coordinator is already configured.
abort.connection_in_use: This connection is already assigned to another Inovonics entry.
abort.different_coordinator: This connection reported a different physical coordinator. Add it as a new integration entry.
abort.unknown_existing_coordinator: Connect the existing Inovonics entry and wait for it to report its serial number before adding another coordinator.

data.alert_seconds: Notify after the coordinator stays offline (seconds)
data.hide_unsupported: Hide reserved and unsupported status bits
data.debug_client: Allowed debug client IPv4 address or subnet

data_description.device_minutes: Use 0 to disable offline detection by default.
data_description.repeater_minutes: Use 0 to disable offline detection by default.
data_description.watchdog_seconds: Set to 0 to disable silence detection. In passthrough, set this above the longest normal gap in coordinator traffic.
data_description.alert_seconds: Set to 0 to disable persistent Home Assistant notifications. The alert clears when coordinator data returns.
data_description.debug_mode: Off by default. Receive mirrors raw bytes, passthrough also forwards writes, and trace outputs direction-tagged hex lines.

set_nid.title: Set coordinator NID
set_nid.description: The connected coordinator currently reports NID {nid}. Changing it can interrupt repeater traffic. A connected passthrough client continues to receive coordinator replies during the change.

data_description.nid: 0 uses broadcast mode. 1–31 use directed mode.

prepare_repeater.title: Prepare repeater {uid}
prepare_repeater.description: Open the repeater and check that its jumper is in directed mode. Keep the housing open and the tamper switch released so the repeater can accept the NID update. Select Continue before pressing reset.

progress.verify_nid: Waiting for the connected coordinator to report NID {nid}.
progress.first_reset: Press the reset button on repeater {uid} within {seconds} seconds. The progress indicator shows how much of the window has elapsed. Home Assistant sends an update only if the reported NID differs from the coordinator's NID ({nid}).
progress.second_reset: The update command was sent to repeater {uid}. Press reset again within {seconds} seconds to verify NID {nid}. The progress indicator shows how much of the window has elapsed.

abort.coordinator_unavailable: The coordinator is unavailable. Wait until it is connected and try again.
abort.coordinator_nid_unverified: Home Assistant could not verify the requested NID. Read the current NID before retrying.
abort.nid_rejected: The coordinator rejected the NID command (NAK {code}). Check the coordinator and repeater before retrying.
abort.no_repeaters: This coordinator has not heard any repeaters yet.
abort.first_reset_timeout: Home Assistant received no reset report from repeater {uid} within {seconds} seconds. Check its power, battery and radio range, then try again.
abort.second_reset_timeout: Home Assistant received no reset report from repeater {uid} within {seconds} seconds of sending the update. Check its power, battery and radio range before retrying.
abort.repeater_nid_mismatch: Repeater {uid} responded to reset and last reported NID {reported}. The expected NID is {nid}. Check directed mode and keep the tamper switch released during the update before retrying.
abort.repeater_failed: The repeater NID was not verified. Check the coordinator's NID and the repeater's jumper before trying again.

error.confirm_nid: Confirm the coordinator NID change to continue.
error.invalid_network: Enter an allowed IPv4 client address or a specific IPv4 subnet.
